tokens.purpose: Light-mode design language source: color, typography, radius, spacing, size, and compatibility aliases.
tokens.downstreamRule: Use canonical --bg-*, --text-*, --icon-*, --border-*, --status-*, --radius-*, and --spacer-* tokens first. Treat --color-* and legacy aliases as compatibility names.

components.purpose: Stable atoms, component-level markup, classes, token consumption, DOM anatomy, assets, and provenance.
components.downstreamRule: Copy markup from preview/component-{slug}.html, link colors_and_type.css + components.css. All component classes use .mf-* prefix. Keep page-local showcase layout out of shared component CSS.

icons.purpose: MyFlicker-specific SVG icon library. All icons use viewBox 0 0 1024 1024 and fill=currentColor.
icons.downstreamRule: Use assets/icons/kid/{name}.svg. Look up available icon names from assets/icons/kid/icon-list.json or preview/icon-browser.html. Inline SVG content inside a <span class="icon"> wrapper. Ensure .icon svg, .icon svg * { fill: currentColor } is present in component CSS block.
icons.legacyNote: Pre-MyFlicker icons in assets/icons/ are still used by ui_kits/ pages and will be removed when M4 UI Kit rewrite is complete. Do not use for new work.

uikit.purpose: Page-level visual showcase and component-composition evidence. Note: current ui_kits pages use pre-MyFlicker icons and legacy .ds-* classes; treat as structural reference only.
uikit.downstreamRule: Read UIKit pages for layout and product patterns only. Do not copy the outer shell as a production page template. Use component previews for reusable markup.

modeA_inlineSvg.useFor: Primary usage. Inline SVG inherits color from parent CSS color token.

modeB_imgTag.useFor: Static HTML where no runtime recoloring is required.

iconUsage.colorRule: Do not edit shipped SVG geometry or invent arbitrary icon colors. Add a semantic token first when a new fixed tint is required.

useTokensOnly.consume: Link the CSS or read css.json for machine consumption.

buildSingleComponent.consume: Copy component markup from preview, keep .mf-* class names, inline kid SVG icons.

buildFullPageCustomCanvas.consume: Use UIKit as structural reference. Write your own responsive outer grid. Use .mf-* component classes and kid icons throughout.

uikitConstraints.warningForDownstream: UIKit pages are legacy showcases using pre-MyFlicker .ds-* classes and icons. Do not copy them as production templates. M4 rewrite will update these pages.
